source_supported: SH944A clutch lever fulcrum bracket: SNL37:008; distinct from rear brake M4131.
SH944B short/SH944C long links: SNL119:026/025, one each. Shaft SH944D: SNL211:032, one; two Woodruff No.15 keys: SNL115:013.
Four 1/2 x1-3/4 inch bolt/plain-nut/lock assemblies at SH944A, SNL31:009. One 1/2 x2-1/2 inch bolt/plain-nut/lock assembly on each SH944B/C, SNL31:011.
M581 rear clutch rod and two 3/4 inch plain nuts: SNL193:007/008. One SH953E fork (87:001), one M569C fork (86:022); retained pin families distinct.
approximations: HB92/SNL6 older control-side illustrations place both clutch swing connections below a pivot; choose separate SNL short and long links in that orientation. Exact correspondence to the older M642/M643 illustration remains provisional.

Woodruff No.15 selected as 25.4 mm diameter, 6.35 mm tangential thickness, 10.31 mm segment height. These inferred size values need independent historical-size evidence; key plane contains shaft axis, unlike Gemini transverse groove.
19.05 mm rod stock, 19.05 mm insertion, installed bends, clearance allowances, nominal threads and neutral angles remain estimates.
Existing half-inch hardware exterior is reused; historical hex-finish dimensions are unresolved.
Trial01 rejects the Gemini-derived engine-crossmember mounting corridor: nine saved-material intersections, including case, flywheel and rear high-control route.

New mounting hypothesis: SH944A supported on floor6 at X3350,Y350, journalZ715, adjacent to the port center-foot controls. This uses the source arrangement qualitatively; exact floor attachment is not established. Four complete source bolts pass through actual floor6 holes with flat locking/nut seats.

M581 rear fork pitches25 degrees downward about its existing transverse receiving pin. Route stays below clutch castings/flywheel, passes outside the port engine supports, then rises to SH944B. Installed bends and short/long link dimensions remain estimates.
